meta.rule: Anything that cannot be confirmed from an official source is published blank and listed here. Nothing on this page blocks the site; these are review items for the owner.

rows: Week 10 PIT@CIN is rendered by the official scores page under LIVE GAMES as 0-0 at Q1 09:08, on 2026-11-16, after the fixture's scheduled date. The official standings page on the same date shows PIT 6-2 and CIN 6-2, i.e. the game is not in either record.
Both scores are left blank and the row is marked unresolved. No score is inferred from either page.
Re-read the official game centre after the league settles the result, and record which page was authoritative.

Decide whether to store the date only and drop the page's day-of-week label.

An inherited requirement in this repository states 'Only 6 of 254 report rows carry a game designation' and '254 rows and 4 no-injury sections'. Neither the row count nor the meaning survives checking. The nfl-lines capture of the same page, taken 2026-11-12 and read here on 2026-11-16, holds 276 rows and 6 designated rows, so the '6' is right for that capture date but '254' is not: the file holds 276. This session's 2026-11-16 capture of the same page holds 347 rows and 171 designated rows.
The stale numbers are not republished. The current counts are computed from the capture at build time.
Retire or re-date the inherited counts. Record the capture day inside every published count, not just in the page header, so two counts of the same page are comparable.

The nfl-lines workspace captured the same official Week 10 injury report on 2026-11-12 and its file holds 276 rows across 28 clubs with 6 designated rows; its own provenance note states 275 rows, which does not match the file. This session captured the same page on 2026-11-16 and found 347 rows across 28 clubs with 171 designated. The per-club counts differ sharply: New England shows 15 listed and 0 Questionable on 2026-11-12, and 15 listed and 9 Questionable on 2026-11-16.
Both are plausible: the report grows and designations appear as the week progresses. Neither is treated as wrong. This is evidence for R-54 and R-55 rather than an error.
Record the capture day inside every published count, not just on the page header.

A scan of all 593 HTML files in this repository found 10 pages of this project containing data rows with no source link at all. The largest: nfl-lines/pages/singles.html (120 of 311 rows), nfl-origination/pages/requirements.html (89 of 89), nfl-book/index.html (40 of 122), nfl-readiness-register/pages/snapshots.html (35 of 87), nfl-price-snapshot/pages/requirements.html (33 of 33), nfl-lines/pages/validation.html (25 of 25), nfl-availability-desk/pages/questions.html (25 of 25), nfl-availability-desk/pages/governance.html (23 of 24), nfl-hub/pages/requirements.html (21 of 21), nfl-lines/pages/parlays.html (20 of 52).
This namespace links every row it can, and marks the rest blank and flagged. The finding is reported, not silently copied.
Agree a convention: rows that are internal decisions (questions, requirements, verdicts) need no official link, and every other row must carry one. See suggestion SG-23.
Backtest numbers published before the price policy is decided

The nfl-lines workspace publishes a completed backtest of 15 strategies covering 19,264 bets, with win rate, ROI, maximum drawdown, prices and p-values, each split into a 2011-2021 development period and a later confirmation period. Overall ROI is positive for 5 of 15 strategies; in the confirmation period, 3 of 15 are positive. The prices come from the nflverse archive via nfl-lines/data/raw, not from a licensed feed. R-20 says decide the price-data policy before publishing any backtest, and R-09 forbids backtest numbers on a leaderboard.
This session publishes no backtest, no ROI, no price and no drawdown. Its leaderboard is empty by construction.

R-20 says decide the price-data policy before any backtest is published, and R-09 forbids backtest numbers on a leaderboard. Confirm whether the nfl-lines backtest is intended to stand, and under which policy. See suggestions SG-01 and SG-15.
The data that clears three gates is already in this repository

nfl-lines/data/raw/nfldata_games.csv (nflverse, 7,548 games, 1999-2026) contains a venue for 150 of 150 of this session's fixtures, a roof for 146, a surface for 79, and spread, total and moneyline for 150 of 150. It also carries 2026 scores for Weeks 1-9 that match the official pages exactly on 136 of 136 games, 0 mismatches.
It is a third-party source, not an official one, so every value from it is published on a separate page marked unverified and is not merged into any official-sourced table.
This is the single highest-value open decision: accepting it clears the venue, roof/surface and historical-price gates at once. See suggestion SG-01 and SG-07.
Weather coverage too sparse for the current season

The nflverse archive carries temperature and wind for only 45 of 272 games in 2026 (it carries 158 to 190 per season for 2023 to 2025). The NWS hourly overlay in R-58 therefore cannot be validated on the current season from that source alone.
No weather value is published. The overlay page states the gap.
Either join the NWS grid directly using the venue coordinates, or validate the overlay on 2023-2025 and accept 2026 as out of sample.
Stale depth-readiness claims after 32-club route sweep

The Origin Board captured on 2026-11-16 says 0/32 clubs have a verified depth source and neither source route has been checked. The committed 2026-11-17 official club-page sweep supersedes that route-coverage statement: pages were present for 32/32 clubs; 31 were machine-readable HTML tables and Houston was image-only. Only 5/32 pages printed an as-of date, and several club pages self-label unofficial or otherwise qualify their status. This sweep does not prove actual game-day starters, participation, or replacement snaps.

Depth-related readiness rows have been updated to distinguish route coverage from starter/participation verification. No depth rank has been promoted to a confirmed starter and Houston values remain blank.
